mapper.select: SELECT g.goods_no, g.goods_id, g.goods_name, g.goods_image, g.category_no, g.wish_cnt, c.category_name, today.price AS price, stats.max_price, stats.min_price, ROUND((stats.max_price - today.price) / stats.max_price * 100, 2) AS discount_rate FROM tb_goods g LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON g.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, price FROM ( SELECT goods_id, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY goods_id ORDER BY register_date DESC) AS rn FROM tb_daily_price ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) today ON g.goods_id = today.goods_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MAX(price) AS max_price, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM tb_daily_price WHERE register_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH GROUP BY goods_id ) stats ON g.goods_id = stats.goods_id WHERE g.goods_no = #{goodsNo}
